usage: The word '瞓覺' (fan3 gaau3) is a verb meaning 'to sleep'.
'瞓覺' can be used to express sleeping in a general sense.
It is commonly used to talk about going to bed or taking a nap.
You can use '瞓覺' with a time expression to indicate when someone sleeps.
It can also be used in negative and question forms, e.g. 唔瞓覺? (Not sleeping?) or 你瞓覺咗未? (Have you slept yet?)
